goal: Verify that a user can register as a Site Host, create a new memo, and successfully navigate to the June 2026 calendar view.

findings.instruction: In the main dashboard, type 'Remember to review the project timeline tomorrow morning.' into the text input box labeled 'Any thoughts...' and click the 'Save' button.
findings.title: Memo creation failed due to incorrect element targeting
findings.description: The test step intended to type text into the 'Any thoughts...' input field but the automation script incorrectly targeted a button element instead. This caused the action to fail, and the memo was not created. The expected state change (memo appearing in the feed) did not occur.
findings.evidence: The error log shows 'fill('button') raised Error: Element is not an <input>...'. The AFTER screenshot shows the 'Any thoughts...' input is still empty and the feed still displays 'No data found.', confirming the memo was not saved.
reproduction_steps: Attempt to type 'Remember to review the project timeline tomorrow morning.' into the text input box labeled 'Any thoughts...' using an incorrect selector that targets a button instead of the input field.
Observe that the action fails and the memo is not created.
